records.text: JFK tried to make Israel follow FARA (Foreign Agents Registration Act) before he was shot
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Don't forget that when JFK tried to put an end to that—well, I guess rather put an end to the Israel exception that we now have by making them sign up and acknowledge FARA, to follow the FARA—they shot him.

verification.notes: JFK's administration (specifically AG Robert F. Kennedy) did pressure the American Zionist Council to register under FARA in Nov 1962. Senate hearings in 1963 under Fulbright revealed Israel lobbying. JFK was assassinated Nov 22, 1963, before enforcement completed. The claim about 'before he was shot' is technically accurate but implies causation.
